why: F122 confirmed that a learned raw-token pairwise matcher can transfer to longer unseen synthetic path lengths, but an engineered role-path selector still provided the relevant junctions. F123 isolates the causal contribution of learned path discovery and relationship composition.
scope: Public synthetic source-only development in isolated Wingless and Yggdrasil lanes. This draft does not amend F122, rerun its consumed confirm split, establish scientific first-use, accept results or authorize an execution controller.
primary_hypothesis: At the same public graph-information budget, an actually trained query-conditioned path-selection mechanism can identify which edge sequence composes the target relation under role-compatible branch collisions and variable aliasing, outperforming a resource-matched learned local-equality-only mechanism on new structural families.

environment.input: Unordered public directed multi-edge graph with raw independently salted 16-bit token pairs, relation-role tokens, source/target query and target relation-role sequence; no preselected true path, edge indices, correct junction flags, graph truth, or oracle indicators.
environment.construction: Each example has at least two query-compatible competing paths to target. Opposing positive and negative counterfactuals swap values on one route edge with an off-route edge while preserving edge types/topology, degree sequence, role multiset, graph-wide raw-symbol multiset, path length and source/target query.
environment.negative_controls: Include near-miss role collisions, shared-prefix branches, shared-suffix branches, repeated alias tokens, off-path syntactic distractors and label-balanced null or ambiguous routes. Cases with genuinely ambiguous truth under the public query are quarantined, not scored.
environment.observation_rule: Raw token encoding may be deterministic and per graph, but neither a variable-equality bit nor an oracle-selected path/changed-junction coordinate is passed to a candidate model.
environment.train_structure: 2–3 hops and two competing paths, with role collisions
environment.confirm_structure: 5–6 hops, three or more competing paths, novel role vocabulary, new seed-origin graph families and altered branch geometry
environment.paired_controls: Randomize whole-edge order and route representation, counterbalance path placement and distractor number, keep paired graph information parity, independently audit labels using a held-out exact public symbolic traversal algorithm.

arms.A: Frozen F122 raw local compatibility learner plus a bounded TRAIN-only learned query-conditioned path ranker; the ranker sees raw edge tokens and relation-role identity but no precomputed equality or privileged selected path.
arms.B: Bounded trainable recurrent graph-message propagation with learned query-dependent edge attention and 5–6 step rollout; no symbolic equality bit, hidden true-path routing or oracle feature.
arms.CTRL_F122_NO_ROUTING: F122 frozen raw matcher with only nonlearned public role-routing heuristic, no hidden target path.
arms.CTRL_PUBLIC_NONLEARNED: Fully specified deterministic public-graph BFS plus exact variable-slot consistency, with the same input information; disclose as a strong symbolic control and computational ceiling.
arms.CTRL_ROLE_ONLY: Public role-compatible reachability ignoring variable identity.
arms.CTRL_QUERY_ONLY: Matched parameter-budget learner with query and public degree/role statistics but no raw edge-identity pairs.
arms.CTRL_SHUFFLE: Frozen learned candidate on edge-token-swapped or role-permuted graph, expected sensitivity diagnostic, not a trainable comparator.

cohorts.model_selection: TRAIN ONLY, one fixed primary paired-accuracy selector, ties to A; no confirmation-driven retuning

evaluation.primary: Per lane and per source candidate: disjoint-confirmation paired correctness (positive and negative both classified correctly), balanced binary accuracy and delta versus the strongest eligible equal-information nonlearned control.
evaluation.secondary: Compute cost, parameter count, branch-collision strata, depth strata, positive/negative errors, false-positive route leakage, path-identity intervention sensitivity, alias robustness and graph information budget.
evaluation.artifact_custody: Bind exact source SHA, freeze blob SHA, environment/candidate digests, TRAIN and CONFIRM cohort digests, selected weights digest and independent control-scoring digests. Preserve original run receipts and all negative or invalid observations.
evaluation.success_precommitment: A developmental path-learning advantage requires at least +0.05 paired accuracy over the strongest non-oracle equal-information comparator in BOTH lanes, no lane or collision-stratum degradation, no holdout selection, and verified nonzero bounded learned parameter updates. Otherwise classify parity, negative or inconclusive; this threshold is not scientific acceptance.
evaluation.leakage_guard: If edge order, marker names, numeric seed range, relation-role spelling, candidate vector or hidden route selection predicts label without raw relationship composition, invalidate claim and preserve diagnostic failure.
evaluation.interpretability: Report route attention/selected-edge witness traces and causal edge ablations with positive, negative and counterfactual cases; a high aggregate score without route attribution does not establish graph-causal reasoning.
evaluation.restriction: Original sealed first-use, production performance, language transfer and general neural reasoning are unproven no matter the outcome.

qualification.focused: Preimplementation hash enforcement, adversarial graph-generation consistency, no preselected path, no oracle/equality feature injection, seed split disjointness, permutation tests, near-miss/ambiguity quarantine, fixed threshold/controls and bounded optimizer updates.
qualification.affected_interface: Existing F118/F120 source-advisory input, F121/F122 graph runners, dual-lane artifact receipt/digest checking; fail closed on source/contract drift.
qualification.final_integration: Once an implementation exists, one exact-head full regression with Ubuntu and Windows CI, build and artifact validation prior to any draft status review; source-only freeze is not a qualified experiment.
qualification.cadence: Use the existing FORGE two-lane development workflow only; do not introduce schedulers, model API calls or independent execution authority.
